contract: ../DESIGN.md and ../ANALYTICS.md — v1.4, compact screen navigation, hidden scrollbar tracks, live-only telemetry, cumulative history and attributed model lookup.

accessibility.evidence: Labeled native selectors replace clipped phone tabs. Wider tabs retain arrows/Home/End, panels/tables are focusable and scrolling remains available with hidden tracks. Arabic physical axle orientation remains fixed. Screen-reader testing remains unperformed.

responsive.evidence: Eight viewport captures inspected, including the annotated 514x913 phone. All seven views and 25 smaller screens checked for horizontal overflow with extra-large numbers. Tablet tabs wrap; landscape instruments fit; phone historical fields use labeled cards.

loading.evidence: Stable initial structure and connecting text before data/schema load.

empty.evidence: With no game stream, waiting state and em dashes remain visible. No fabricated demo values.

error.evidence: Forbidden UDP port submitted through browser form; existing receiver retained and error shown. Endpoint tests verify occupied-port rollback.

partial.evidence: Missing/insufficient lap and suspension statistics display em dashes; parser tests reject partial datagrams.

success.evidence: 18 automated tests pass, including receiver-independent extrema/persistence, corrupt-file preservation, lap rewind, community lookup and local UDP transport. Packaged desktop launch checked. Historical field-card fit checked with explicit isolated fixture and cleared.

permission.evidence: Browser fullscreen request and exit completed without exception during UI check. OS firewall permission is documented separately and remains hardware-untested.

renderedEvidence.observation: English dark settings, no sound or demo controls; size/theme/language options present.
Arabic light phone front-axle screen with large readouts and View/Screen selectors.
Landscape cockpit places speed/RPM/vehicle and the powertrain strip inside the initial viewport.
Spanish tablet lap screen, wrapped session tabs all visible.
French dark analysis; translated graph tabs and waiting state.
Arabic portrait chassis; physical left/right corners preserved, translated labels and large values.
English light language/theme/number-size settings on a wide monitor.

Receiver controls fit 514x913 with title/toolbar and scrollbar tracks removed. Recaptured on 1.6.0 for publication; the original address capture is kept outside the repository because it contained local LAN addresses.
